steps.say: A noun names a person, place, animal or thing.
Names of people, places and days start with a capital letter.
Most nouns add s for more than one. Nouns ending in s, x, sh or ch add es.
If a noun ends in a consonant and y, change the y to i and add es.
Some plurals are special. Learn them by heart.
steps.show: child, children / mouse, mice / foot, feet
